interventions.hypothesis: High-confidence operation controls must be consumed by typed operation semantics rather than treated as payload or silently ignored.
interventions.stage1_evidence: 22 materialization-bound cases whose first blocker involved source field 'operation'

interventions.hypothesis: Explicit group-local conflict semantics in the request must not be degraded to needs_clarification or a contradictory action/target.
Explicit requested update columns define a closed update set and must survive planning/materialization without omission, silent unknown-column loss, or contradiction with exclusions.
interventions.stage1_evidence: 4 executed-but-wrong update-column omission cases plus latent relationship-column expansion cases

interventions.hypothesis: Explicit row boundaries and conservative textual-null semantics prevent deterministic source-parser row collapse, control-row fabrication, and TEXT-to-NULL corruption.

hardening_invariants: database identifiers use quote-stripped casefold exact keys; underscores/punctuation are preserved
conflict action controls are distinct from conflict target controls
structured operation controls use exact alias matching only
free-text conflict restoration requires high-confidence instruction syntax after quoted literals are masked
V0 materialization omits Stage-2-only role metadata when control_field_roles is false
method_variant and method_version are recorded in run lock, manifest, sample-level artifacts, and summary metadata
d_invariants: D is independently ablatable through structured_source_parser.enabled
repeated explicit row markers/headings remain separate rows with stable SRC_ROW_* IDs
strong control-only blocks are metadata, never payload rows
unquoted textual NULL is explicit null; ambiguous text None/nil is preserved as text
quoted textual null markers are preserved as text
A-C logic remains frozen and is only consumed through existing interfaces
